class: A change to a migration, a database function or a route's reply breaks database-backed tests in OTHER files (round-trip, pin and exact-reply tests written when an older state was newest), and nothing local runs them: the gate runs only the database-free app tests, and the builder runs only its own files, so the red appears only in CI after the push.
mechanism: Occurrence 1 (row 27, PR #540): GET /api/catalogue/{u}/expiries gained expiry_days; tests_app/test_pinned_clock.py:140 compared the whole reply and failed only in CI (run 40132982617). Occurrence 2 (row 29, PR #541): migration 0025 re-created ofo_strategy_change_items_valid without publishing NEW_PINS, so tests_app/test_strategy_shape_matrix.py:409 kept the 0011 pin; and tests_app/test_migration_0024_typed_entry.py:194 compared grants after the whole down-chain with the head grants, which 0025's downgrade legitimately changes (run 40146949616). select_app_tests.py selects by route/module keys and does not select migration round-trip or pin tests for a new migration; the gate's app-selected step runs only DB-free files.

first_seen.where: chunk 3 session A, PR #540 and PR #541
first_seen.evidence: CI api job: #540 '1 failed, 3963 passed' (test_pinned_clock.py:140); #541 '2 failed, 4061 passed' (test_migration_0024_typed_entry.py:194 grants; test_strategy_shape_matrix.py:409 md5 e6970479... != 13f59a46...).

fix: Mechanism due at this second occurrence: before reporting, a builder whose diff touches backend/ofo_app/alembic/, a *_store.py or a route reply runs EVERY database test that select_app_tests.py selects plus every tests_app/test_migration_*.py and tests_app/test_strategy_shape_matrix.py through scripts/orchestrator/db_run_fresh.py (a throwaway database per run). Now: a standing line in docs/process/builder-brief.md. Next: the gate runs that set itself when such a file changed (a gate change - the next chunk's process item, owner to count it). Instances fixed: test_pinned_clock.py assertion; 0025 publishes NEW_PINS; the 0024 round-trip test takes its grant snapshot at 0024 (after the later migrations' downgrades).

detection.note: CI catches it after the push (each occurrence cost one red CI run, ~15 min, and a re-review). No local check yet; the builder-brief line is prose until the gate step exists.
